LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.channelCapacity_p: For a finite family of channels Wⱼ with finite alphabets and nonempty input alphabets, the capacity of their parallel product is ∑ⱼ C(Wⱼ), even when the supremum allows correlated inputs. The formula also covers the empty family.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.channelCapacity_m: For a finite channel W with a nonempty input alphabet, n independent uses have capacity nC(W) for every natural n, including zero.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.mutualInfo_channe: Under any input distribution on length-n words, even with dependent coordinates, the mutual information through n memoryless uses of a finite channel W with nonempty input alphabet is at most nC(W).
